build_hadamard_transform: build a hadamard transform instance by type name such as hadamard or random_hadamard with kwargs
create_HadamardTransform: create a deterministic block-diagonal Hadamard rotation module with a given block size and device
create_RandomHadamardTransform: create a randomly signed Hadamard rotation module with a seed for reproducible transforms
review_HADAMARDS: review the HADAMARDS registry dict that maps type strings to HadamardTransform subclass constructors
summarize_filter_kwarg_dict: summarize the filter_kwarg_dict helper that returns only kwargs accepted by a given function signature
